title: LeetCode Question Tracker
tagline: Personal DSA revision tool for solved problem tracking.
shortDescription: Personal DSA revision tool for recording solved LeetCode problems, solution code, status and tags.
description: Personal DSA revision tool for recording solved LeetCode problems, solution code, status and tags.

caseStudy.problem: Previously solved DSA questions and approaches can become difficult to find during revision.
caseStudy.solution: Centralize solved questions, code and tags in a dedicated revision application.
features: Store LeetCode questions and problem tags
Store solution code and revision status
Retrieve and filter questions for structured revision
